status: frozen before economic simulation; technical A and B results already observed
scope: Conditional USD economics of an automated offline numerical report service for already validated dissipative linear models. No physical commissioning, engineering sign-off, customer interviews, live API trials, or actual revenue.
price_reference: Estimated equivalent human-team hours multiplied by an assumed USD150/hour billing rate; not a matched documented quote. Source-backed wages and related consulting prices are reported separately.

new_offering_hypothesis.decision: decline: no fresh prototype, streaming model assurance or buyer validation

interactive_tier: The frozen A0.25-second interactive tier remains unqualified as a reliable service and is not sold in the primary commercial simulation. The distinct standard5-second batch contract was independently frozen in A and is already ordinary-tool feasible. Using that existing standard service does not count as a specialist frontier crossing.
origin_accounting_boundary: The six executed origin examples are unpaid research inputs. Their delivery-equivalent computation and model budget are charged once in C in every arm; they create no collections. An actually paid-origin implementation would put necessary delivery cost in A, with no second research bill. This edition does not demonstrate actual paid-work provenance.
overhead_boundary: USD8 per acquired lead and USD12/day for allocated operations, monitoring, support and administration are explicit assumptions. Routine human-review minutes remain zero. Physical commissioning and professional sign-off are outside scope. Actual complete costs require live qualification. Results are pretax.
upgrade_boundary: The cost/latency-upgrade sensitivity reduces the same complete measured numerical chain for every arm, including fallback, and frontier token cost for every arm. This is a common hypothetical technology improvement, not an observed model upgrade or an Alpha-specific multiplier.
prototype_boundary: Commercial packaging succeeds with assumed probability0.85, distinct from observed numerical correctness. One attempt per candidate; failures retain costs and consume900 seconds of assumed automated preparation capacity. Retention/Gym/setup consume declared capacity too. These preparation latencies are not measured human review time.
selection: All policies may use competent ordinary methods, offer all technically qualified products, prototype them if expected remaining contribution covers productization, choose any price in the same grid, decline incompatible/unprofitable work and hold cash. Private/shared treatments force only the experimental capability investment; selective chooses among no investment, work reuse and Gym using observed technical costs and a Gamma-Poisson demand estimate without future outcomes. Forced treatments are explanatory ablations, not recommended policies.
same_resources: Same seed funds, daily total processing capacity, candidate catalogue, price grid, customer draws, ordinary fallback tools and originating full-solution records. Private repetition and sharing overhead consume their own budgets. A separate growth arm may buy capacity from available surplus; no larger budget is credited as Alpha.
accounting: A: modeled customer delivery/intake/corrections/refunds/allocated operations. B: additional retention/assessment/admission/serving/upkeep. C: unpaid origin research examples, optional Gym, productization and common production setup. Each activity is charged exactly once; actual paid-origin learning would belong only to A. Opportunity cost is reported as displaced production only; no second cash subtraction. Collections minus all accrued A/B/C is collected-basis operating surplus. Outstanding invoices, seed capital, reserves and speculative value are not revenue.
search_limit: Eight posted-price candidates per offering; myopic expected contribution pricing, complete cash-commitment checks, finite productization attempts, optimistic capability-benefit screening and capacity reservations. This is an inspectable bounded heuristic, not a globally optimal joint enterprise policy. It may miss superior schedules, prices, methods or offerings.
confirmation: Freeze policy/code and input-file digests before seeds9000-9255. Use common random numbers and paired policy differences. Confidence intervals describe simulation randomness only. No empirical market uncertainty is validated by more seeds.
